projects.name: Sine Rally
projects.tagline: The game. It started as a prototype, became the classic build (leck-games/sinerally) and continues as sinerally-ui, which is Sine Rally V0.1.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 1
versions.title: Prototype
versions.desc: The first playable Sine Rally, where it all started. An endless math world made only of sine waves (no stored heightmap), procedurally generated dirt race tracks with 8 gates, a buggy with jumps, drift and boost, and touch joystick controls.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 2
versions.title: Comic look
versions.desc: Graphics overhaul into the comic / cel-shaded style: ink outlines, cel + hatching shaders, stylized terrain, water and sky, a new buggy and props, quality toggle.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 3
versions.title: Merged release
versions.desc: The prototype merged with the engine build: rigid-body 4x4 physics, 5 terrain regions, a road graph with bridges, GPU grass, near/far terrain and a gauge HUD, all rendered in comic shading.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 4
versions.title: Free roam
versions.desc: Free-roam release: breakable trees and props, handling assists, 3 vehicles, day/night with weather, fuel cans, vistas, a world map with waypoint + teleport. Comic style on every GFX level.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 5
versions.title: Engine sound plugins
versions.desc: Engine Sound Plugin API v1: the game hosts engine-sound plugins (Engine Sim vendored, plus a simple example) chosen from the menu.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 6
versions.title: iPhone home screen
versions.desc: Installs as an iOS home-screen app: icons, manifest, safe-area layout, touch guards and an 'All builds' link to the launcher.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 7
versions.title: New grass
versions.desc: Grass ported from the engine build: smooth root-to-tip gradient, paler greener blades; black-grass bug fixed and rain darkens the blades.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 8
versions.title: Physics + terrain merge
versions.desc: The physics and terrain modules join the game: 5 cars with attachments, trees with HP, grass fire from engine heat, forest weather, and the in-game engine sound editor (Engine Sim 1.1 with rotary engines).

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 9
versions.title: Classic final
versions.desc: Final build of the classic game (repo frozen here): the harvester melts trees at any speed, wider roads, ARCADE handling by default, FULL / MINIMAL / NONE UI modes.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 10
versions.title: HUD layout editor
versions.desc: First Sine Rally UI build: a fork of the classic final with a fully customizable touch HUD. Move, scale, fade or hide every control in the layout editor.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 11
versions.title: Planes + graphics levels
versions.desc: Flyable planes (bush cub, stunt plane, jet) on procedural airfields with a flight HUD, plus LOW / MED / HIGH / ULTRA graphics with HD road textures.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 12
versions.title: UI redesign
versions.desc: Big UI redesign: corner ☰ ⚙ buttons with a quick tray, a tabbed safe-area menu, a context-aware HUD and an engine editor matching the Engine Sim demo.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 13
versions.title: Comic tree LOD
versions.desc: Trees use one comic impostor LOD at every distance (138k fewer forest triangles) with trunk cracks, so forests are cheaper and look consistent.

versions.label: pre-0.1 build 14
versions.title: Race rings + compass
versions.desc: Race starts become glowing rings with light pillars, a FUEL-style 360° compass appears at the top, and checkpoint gates turn to face along the track.

versions.label: V0.1
versions.title: Sine Rally V0.1
versions.desc: The first numbered release. Everything in the earlier builds, plus a compact checkpoint toast with best splits, and the next checkpoint and waypoint shown as compass badges (edge arrows when behind you). Version tag in the menu with a link back here.

projects.name: SineHighway
projects.tagline: (formerly Sine Rally Route) An endless, curvy Route-66-style road through prairie, red-rock desert, forest, snowy mountains and coast. Forked from sinerally-ui.

versions.label: V0.1
versions.title: Sine Rally Route V0.1
versions.desc: The first Route build: one procedural, endless two-lane road with grades capped at about 10%, tunnels and bridges, and a floating origin (tested on 50+ km drives). Five biomes blend every few km, with mesas, cactus and palms, mile markers and diners. A route strip HUD shows km driven and the next biome, and the autopilot is key O.

versions.label: V0.2
versions.title: SineHighway V0.2
versions.desc: Renamed to SineHighway. Holding the throttle now shifts up to the top gear and stays there, with no hunting at top speed or on climbs. A new MANUAL gearbox option (CONTROLS & HUD) shifts with a swipe up or down on the gas pedal while you keep holding it, or with the X / Z keys. It has a rev limiter and an over-rev guard, the HUD gear flashes on each shift, and the autopilot still uses the auto box.

projects.name: Sine Rally Engine
projects.tagline: The engine test build: physics, terrain and roads before the comic merge.

versions.title: Engine build
versions.desc: Rigid-body vehicle physics, multi-region math terrain, a road graph with bridges, instanced grass and a gauge HUD.

versions.title: iPhone home screen
versions.desc: The same engine build, installable as an iOS home-screen app (icons, manifest, safe area, touch guards).

projects.name: Engine Sim
projects.tagline: The procedural engine sound simulator that powers Sine Rally's engine audio.

versions.title: First engine sound
versions.desc: A procedural per-cylinder engine sound simulator with firing lights. Build an engine and rev it.

versions.title: Plugin API
versions.desc: Engine Sound Plugin API v1, the interface the game uses to load Engine Sim. The standalone page hosts the plugin itself.

versions.title: Rotary + 16 cylinders
versions.desc: Rotary engines with 1 to 16 rotors, inline / V / boxer up to 16 cylinders, plugin v1.1 that lets a host read and set the engine config, and a fix for iPhone sound when the silent switch is on.

projects.name: Physics Lab
projects.tagline: Standalone test page for the vehicles, attachments and damage module.

versions.title: Vehicles + attachments
versions.desc: The physics / vehicles / attachments modules with a standalone test page: tree HP, engine heat, car selector.

versions.title: Harvester + arcade handling
versions.desc: The harvester melts anything at any speed, ARCADE handling (default) with a NORMAL toggle, plus drift / slalom / landing / top-speed tests.

projects.name: Terrain
projects.tagline: Standalone test build for biomes, forests, fire and weather.

versions.title: Biomes + fire
versions.desc: The terrain module: biomes, trees with 3 HP, grass fire and forest weather in a comic test build.

versions.title: New grass
versions.desc: Grass gets the engine-build look (smooth root-to-tip gradient, paler greener blades), now on the iOS home-screen-ready build.

versions.title: Wider roads
versions.desc: Highways twice as wide (24 m), dirt trails and loops 1.5x, bridges check both road edges.
